name: Docker
description: Docker CE, Docker Compose et Portainer CE

external.name: Docker CE
external.cmd: sudo bash -c 'install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && . /etc/os-release && CODENAME=${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME} && echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu ${CODENAME} stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list && apt update && apt install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin && usermod -aG docker $SUDO_USER'

external.name: Portainer CE
external.cmd: sudo docker volume create portainer_data && sudo docker run -d -p 8000:8000 -p 9443:9443 --name portainer --restart=always -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v portainer_data:/data portainer/portainer-ce:lts
